rationale: manhart_pwls_tv-claude-agentic: val_n=200, pwls_gamma=1.0, pwls_weight_norm=mean, tv_lambda=0.0001, tv_iterations=200, tv_lr=0.01, tv_decay=0.01, tv_optimizer=gd, tv_init=fbp, rationale=iter-3 PWLS-ACTIVATION (lower lambda). DIAGNOSIS: iter-1 (gamma=1.0) hr=0.16647825 and iter-2 (gamma=0.0 plain TV) hr=0.16647791 differ only at the 8th sig-digit (dHR~3.4e-7) => PWLS ray-weight is INERT at tv_lambda=0.001 (TV term dominates data term, same as Mayo). To let the data term BITE so Manhart's gamma can shape the recon: ONE knob tv_lambda 0.001->1e-4 (10x drop; gamma=1.0 full Manhart kept). HYPOTHESIS: at 10x lower lambda the data-fidelity term is non-negligible, so (a) hr moves materially and (b) PWLS weighting starts to matter; if hr improves this is the productive regime, if it collapses (under-regularized/noisy on 128-view sparse) I back off toward 3e-4. All else fixed from iter-1. Budget: iter-1/2 ran ~200-270s<<1200s.
